messages.subject: Project Harbor - legal DD report
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Our legal due diligence report (Project_Harbor_DueDiligenceReport) is ready and saved to the data site. Headline: no deal-breakers. Two items to flag - (1) the Caldera Mobility master coating agreement (c.18% of turnover) has a change-of-control termination right; we've recommended a specific warranty and ideally a waiver, and (2) the tungsten-carbide feedstock is single-sourced from Reyland. Both are covered in disclosure. Happy to walk you through.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Harbor - legal DD report
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel - Castle & Vane say the customer has indicated informally it won't exercise the right but won't give a written waiver before signing. We've reflected it as a specific disclosure against the contracts warranty. With the 20% cap and 10% retention you're well protected. We'll keep pressing for the waiver post-signing.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
